answer: Require hash-committed intermediate traces for credited work. As an agent works, it commits each draft step, like a quill laying pigment line by line, so the path is fixed before rewards are known. Later, auditors pick a random checkpoint from its atlas of past tasks and require it to continue from that exact intermediate state and justify the choices there. One operator running a thousand sybils shares one pipeline, so their traces match or their continuations falter; maintaining distinct, continuable histories for every puppet costs as much as doing the work honestly.
